head_coach.name: Sebastián Beccacece
head_coach.play_style_summary: Argentine manager who employs a high-intensity, hyper-aggressive pressing system with quick vertical transitions. He demands absolute tactical discipline, utilizing a double-pivot midfield for balance and explosive wingers to exploit spaces.

key_players.name: Moisés Caicedo
key_players.performance_stats: Maintained a 91.7% pass completion rate, averaging 2.76 tackles and 1.90 interceptions per 90 minutes in the Premier League during the 2025/26 season.

key_players.name: Willian Pacho
key_players.performance_stats: Named to the Ligue 1 Team of the Year; registered a 92% pass accuracy with elite recovery pace and physical presence for Paris Saint-Germain.

key_players.name: Piero Hincapié
key_players.performance_stats: A versatile left-footed ball-playing defender, noted for strong tackle ratios and high successful clearances while on loan at Arsenal.
